title: Duplicate command delivery
objective: Retry commands; recognize duplicate resources or unintended second swaps.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: JavaScript enabled in a modern browser; open the file directly.
Fixed original provision/routing/cleanup records and same-key retry records; no operational interface.
actions: Choose remembered results or the blind replay counterexample, and complete or unavailable cleanup evidence.
Inspect three originals, retry the same three keys, verify observations, predict and retain.
Inspect retained evidence; new attempt retains history; reset clears all in-memory data.
syntheticInput: fixtures.js: three logical operations, six fixed deliveries, four deterministic combinations
expectedAssertions: Remembered results and complete receipts: PASS with one candidate, one swap, one intended removal and no retry effects.
Blind replay: FAIL with one duplicate resource, one extra swap and routing to a removed resource.
Unavailable cleanup retry receipt: UNKNOWN unless another known fault already requires FAIL; always retain the unknown.
Every operation remains inspectable by fixed operation key, delivery ID, payload, actor stamp and receipt.
persistence: In-memory only; reload or explicit full reset clears it.
limitations: No actual shell, file, resource, provisioning, routing, cleanup or swap operation.
No Azure/native command retry, resource idempotency, swaps or audit-identity certification.
Offline Playwright 1.56.1, signed Edge 156 and Node 22 are test tooling, not production Node 24 validation.
No user-journey migration success rate, source-parent completion or five-nines evidence.
